[element-season]
=== `<season>` Season (in a citation)

Season of publication, such as “Spring”. Used inside a date named within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>).

<<element-date,`<date>`>>, <<element-date-in-citation,`<date-in-citation>`>>, <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>, <<element-string-date,`<string-date>`>>
